lines: Venerable Vīrāvalī-yoga this would be Khecarī-procedure; by kissing form by mouth, which principle is heard supreme.
l4.sanskrit_cite: śrīmadvīrāvalīyoga eṣa syātkhecarīvidhiḥ cumbākāreṇa vaktreṇa yattattvaṃ śrūyate param
